With ease and confidence, there will be interactive lessons and engaging topics. You will get a chance to learn new vocabulary words, practice speaking skills for your daily communication.

During the last years I had the great opportunity to help many students to get through their language struggles by encouraging them to speak the language and to not be afraid of talking in both German and English. I do never follow a strict pattern as long as this is not desired by the student, I think everyone is unique and in order to match the needs of each every person I adjust my teaching style. Some people enjoy working with books while others prefer being guided through the language in a different way. I will help you to feel more comfortable when talking to someone whose native language is German, teach you about the German culture, we do also talk about “every-day-situations” you will learn simple phrases which are useful when you buy something or if you meet someone for the first time. Hallo zusammen! Ich bin der Lars und lebe in Berlin. Ich unterrichte seit sechs Jahren Deutsch, des Weiteren Englisch seit fast sieben Jahren. teacher_info.about_teacher:
I don't have a particular teaching method but I do try to incorporate their interests into the passages we use for reading exercises or the audio that we might use for a speaking exercise. I think this is a great way to help students be interested in the lesson and also connect with the material better. 

I can help you work on improving your conversation, vocabulary, grammar and much more. I really would like to set up a book club one day with all my students so we can keep in touch and improve our English even more!
teacher_info.teaching_style: Some of the materials that I like to use in my lessons are textbooks, presentations, videos and articles. These will all be shared online before or during our lessons and will be customized to suit your needs. You can select your lesson times and choose whether or not you want to be tested daily, weekly or monthly if at all. There's absolutely no pressure. You should learn English at your pace and I will guide you through it and teach you everything I know!

exp_info.description: In addition to my duties as a frontend developer, I also had to take part in business meetings, write emails and converse with my team daily to complete our projects on time. So this has given me a good experience with using Business English in a professional work environment which I can use to teach my students.

I handle all the writing and marketing for the company and our clients. This has kept me on top of my copy and content writing skills and allowed me to work with some of the different varieties of the English language. Because I am used to it, I can teach my students American, British or Australian English spelling and pronunciation if they require it.
